Driver stack at BP=573e at 0xffdd5d62
92 57 76 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 b2 00 80 04 59 03 00 10 92 57 00 00 00 00 00 00 80 04 08 04

Request command 10h, category 03h, function 73h.
Both parameter/data pointers are 0003:0000. The dispatcher normalizes
selectors <= 3 to zero; LES SI,[BP+8] therefore loads ES=0000.
The driver then reads ES:SI at 03f8:0971 and correctly takes #GP(0).
